caption: The drawing features a decorative pattern consisting of geometric shapes resembling rectangular and trapezoidal blocks, all outlined with parallel lines in shades of brown, beige, and white. The pattern has a repeating arrangement where each block is filled with a white, crackled texture set against a beige-brown background, creating a contrast. Adorning the intersections and some of the borders of these blocks are clusters of grape-like round shapes and large, white grape leaves with brown shading, giving a sense of foliage. Additional ornamental flourishes in beige and brown, such as swirls and small curls, are interspersed at the edges and intersections. The entire patterned composition is framed by a wide, plain light brown border.
title: Wall Paper
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
